import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

CATEGORIES = ["Electronics", "Clothing", "Home Decor", "Automotive", "Books"]

def task_func(s1, s2):
    def _to_series(x):
        if isinstance(x, pd.Series):
            return x.reindex(CATEGORIES)
        if isinstance(x, dict):
            return pd.Series(x).reindex(CATEGORIES)
        arr = list(x)
        idx = CATEGORIES[: len(arr)]
        return pd.Series(arr, index=idx).reindex(CATEGORIES)

    ser1 = _to_series(s1).astype(float)
    ser2 = _to_series(s2).astype(float)

    mask = (ser1 > 200) & (ser2 > 200)

    if not mask.any():
        return None, 0.0

    cats = [c for c in CATEGORIES if bool(mask.loc[c])]
    vals1 = ser1.loc[cats].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    vals2 = ser2.loc[cats].to_numpy(dtype=float)

    distance = float(np.linalg.norm(vals1 - vals2))

    x = np.arange(len(cats))
    width = 0.35

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(x - width / 2, vals1, width, label="Store 1")
    ax.bar(x + width / 2, vals2, width, label="Store 2")

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(cats, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_ylabel("Sales")
    ax.set_title("Sales Comparison for Categories Above Threshold")
    ax.legend()
    fig.tight_layout()

    return ax, distance
